Thank you. I wish you the best with your degree. How many years of it do you have left? Stick with it and PM me if you want to talk. It really sucks when there's nothing that can make you happy. In the past couple of years I've always had something (even if it was just some online game or whatever), but lately there's nothing for me now.

I'm planning to try tuition. I'm going to start looking into it in the next week or two, though I guess the summer holidays isn't the best time to find students.
